_readme: Declarative shot list for tools/capture/capture.mjs. See tools/capture/README.md.
Per-shot fields:
id           required, unique, filename-safe. Output is <out>/<id>.png.
description  one line, shown in logs, report.json and contact-sheet labels.
url          page path, resolved against the server origin. Query params are
kept; the harness always forces ?autostart=0 and ?backend=<backend>.
backend      'webgl2' (default) or 'webgpu'.
setup        JS run after the engine is ready, BEFORE the warmup frames.
Use for scene state that the simulation should then settle into.
warmupFrames deterministic frames stepped at a fixed 1/60 s delta, so temporal
effects converge and animation reaches a known pose.
pose         JS run AFTER the warmup, immediately before the capture render.
Use for the camera: modules re-drive the camera every update, so a
camera set in `setup` is overwritten during the warmup.
mode         'readback' (default, GPU->RenderTarget->PNG, no DOM) or
'screenshot' (page.screenshot, includes DOM/HUD layers).
guard        per-shot blank-frame threshold overrides; keys must exist in
DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS in frame-guard.mjs.
Scripts are strings, or arrays of lines which are joined with newlines. They run
as async function bodies with these bindings: d2rim, engine, ctx, scene, camera,
renderer, time, services, events, THREE.
Scene facts these baselines are composed against (src/scene/ReferenceScene.ts):
sun elevation 27 deg, azimuth 42 deg -> direction (0.596, 0.454, 0.662)
horizontal sun bearing (0.669, 0.743); shadows fall along (-0.669, -0.743)
torus knot at (0, 1.72, 0) r~1.03 on a 2.6 m plinth; brass posts at (+-4, 1.15, 0)
metal roughness sweep at z ~ -4.5, red dielectric sweep at z ~ +4.0, x in [-5.2, 5.2]

pose: // Tight on the hero so anisotropy, reflection sharpness and normal detail

// Cropping the frame instead keeps the standoff and throws away only the

shots.description: Backlit rim light: camera into the sun, subjects silhouetted, shadows thrown toward the lens.
